items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: Joe Harris plays with you sometimes, whenever you couldn't get capped.

ctx.x: Well I liked that from being on Boots, Austin Young, an old man named Austin Young. I used to watch the way he played his bass, you know. But I played with Earl Foster during that time. We had a... In fact, Earl Foster's on there, he had the first four piece band in the city. They had Willie Jam, Louis Jam's brother. That's, of course, both of them did. Willie did too. Now, Louis Jam and another, ain't no way than Willie, but they had another jam. I was playing with you. Boots played a bass. Joe Harris played…
Joe Harris plays with you sometimes, whenever you couldn't get capped.
Well Joe Harris took Willie Jam and played after he went to California.
